t: Saxby CosmosEco V3 Fixed Fire-Rated LED Recessed Downlights provide a reliable and efficient lighting solution for various indoor applications. These 6W, 500 lumen cool white (4000K) downlights are an excellent choice for electricians fitting new lighting in domestic and commercial properties, including bathrooms and kitchens, thanks to their IP65 rating and fire protection. Installation is straightforward with a 4-way, screwless push-fit terminal block and a standard 57mm cut-out. Dimmable functionality allows for adjustable light levels, and the integrated LEDs offer a long 50,000-hour life, ensuring dependable performance and energy efficiency.
